idle_exclusion.method: merged timeline over main thread/session and all subagents; gaps with no events anywhere exceed the threshold and are excluded

limitations: codex rollouts contain no explicit approval-request/response event types (verified by scanning all local sessions); permission-blocked idle cannot be distinguished from user-away time with certainty
candidates are gaps > idle threshold between a tool/turn boundary and a user message / new turn in approval-aware threads; expect false positives when the user stepped away

accounting_notes: opencode: session token columns are per-session (subagents have their own sessions); total_from_all_sessions sums them

notes: the evaluation agent classifies which sessions belong to the contestant run; unextractable choices are surfaced as questions
